svg.title: GLD long-first period set - not selected, in-sample ceiling
svg.desc: LONG-FIRST period set - NOT selected (exposure 55.6% vs 70% floor); coverage bought exposure (+17pp) and paid Sharpe (-0.15) + maxDD (+14pp); 7 uncovered segments, longest 1433d; residual holes bounded by the 15% hit bar, not the budget. CEILING: every metric here is an IN-SAMPLE CEILING on the same history the periods were fit on. The oracle buys the whole book all-in on every pinned buy date and sells all-out on every pinned sell date, so it measures PERIOD QUALITY, never achievable performance — real DCA drips and cannot buy one close. Only the split-sample read (fit on the first half, score on the unseen second half) says anything out-of-sample-ish, and both sides must be read next to this sentence. The long-first rebuild changes WHICH periods are chosen, not what the number means: selecting on prominence and capping covered days is still selection on the same history, so pure-long and every graded rung are the same kind of ceiling.

frozen objective: maximize oracle Sharpe, tie-break Calmar, then CAGR, subject to a time-in-market floor of 70.0% of days (period_optimize.EXPOSURE_FLOOR_PCT /
Qualification 1: the +17pp exposure / -0.15 Sharpe / +14pp maxDD deltas are vs the 3b-equiv arm (report-only), scored REPORT-ONLY in
.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-02-long-first-periods/task-3c-report.md section 5 and filed in NO json (+17.4pp / -0.15 / +14.4pp as printed there); it is drawn hatched below,
Qualification 2: the hit-bar bound speaks for the two largest holes (1433d and 1228d, no hit trough candidate inside them). The 313d hole is CAP-bound instead: trough
budget 1371 of 1374 days is already spent, and the two kinds are capped independently.
2004-11-18..2026-09-29, 5499 bars; source .scratch/gold_period_ladder_postfix.json (variant post-fix (Plan 21 Task 3c: coverage-first trough budget)), data sha256
A. GLD close, the 28 kept long windows (14 peak / 14 trough) and the 7 stretches left uncovered
green band = trough window (buy) | red band = peak window (sell) | dark green outline = coverage-placed trough | red dashed = displaced trough | hatched grey = uncovered stretch

Hatched bands = the 7 segments coverage could not close (1433d, 1228d, 782d, 343d, 334d, 313d, 298d); the two biggest are 2016-02-16..2020-01-18, 2020-08-05..2023-12-15. Each is a stretch with NO trough window, i.e. flat.
Struck pins are troughs coverage spent elsewhere (2005-11-04, 2006-02-13, 2007-08-16, 2008-09-11, 2008-11-12, 2025-11-04) - all 6 were hit windows; dashed outlines are the bands they gave up.
B. Where the trough budget went: 12 coverage placements (dot = placed window mid; label = pin + gap_days bought)

Walk order (Plan 21 Ruling 3): longest gap first, earliest on a tie, best hit trough by prominence. gap_days is the segment length AT PLACEMENT TIME, so later placements quote a partly closed map - read panel A for the holes that stayed.
C. What the set buys and what it costs (no time axis; in-sample ceilings)

pure_long is NOT selected: exposure 55.59% below the frozen 70.0% time-in-market floor. The ladder adds nothing - rung 1 is ABANDONED unhit (medium_peak_20041203_pm15 caught a 4.74% move over 21 bars, below the ...), so the medium rungs never bought a single day.
Window day share (%) of a 1374d budget
What coverage bought (vs the report-only 3b-equivalent arm): +17.4pp exposure 55.59% vs 38.17%, -0.15 Sharpe 0.5032 vs 0.6529, +14.4pp maxDD 40.64% vs 26.25% - and it
Both comparators are invested from day 0 (100% by construction) and both beat the pure-long ceiling on Sharpe; flat DCA also halves the drawdown (27.33% vs 40.64%).
Day shares are SEPARATE quantities under a per-kind cap - only PEAK days bound the exposure floor (24.86% peak / 24.93% trough of 1374d each), so the trough walk cannot
Split-sample out-of-sample side: Sharpe 0.00, exposure 0.00% - 0 acted dates on the unseen half (the filed binary split-side defect). It is a limitation, not a result.

LONG-FIRST period set - NOT selected (exposure 55.6% vs 70% floor); coverage bought exposure (+17pp) and paid Sharpe (-0.15) + maxDD (+14pp); 7 uncovered segments, longest 1433d; residual holes bounded by the 15% hit bar, not the budget.
